title: Projected Dynamic Programming for Sequential Quantum State Discrimination
summary: Sequential Quantum State Discrimination (SQSD) can be naturally framed as a sequential decision-making problem: at each time step, an agent must decide whether to perform an additional measurement to gather more information or to conclude with an optimal decision based on the current belief. In this paper, we formally cast SQSD into a static-hidden-state Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) framework.
